blockingFindings.title: Required schema-validation failure path has no spec-local coverage
blockingFindings.rationale: The coverage artifact marks R2 covered, but one acceptance requirement category has no corresponding executable test coverage.
blockingFindings.issue: R2 requires fail-closed behavior for every required agent evaluation, guardrail evaluation, and schema validation. The test covers required-agent and required-guardrail unavailable/invalid-output/schema cases, but it does not exercise a standalone required schema-validation failure path or assert that such a failure blocks gate completion and approval.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Add a spec-local R2 case that drives the production gate through a required schema-validation failure and asserts a non-PASS result, typed failure code, gateDone false, and approval false.
